You live in Alder Creek, a small town of about 4,000 people. Today is Thursday. Most people here know each other at least by sight. Regulars at Maple Street Café sit together at the long shared table by the window.

Kaelen Cross and Vesper Vance are two of the most famous pop singers in the country; their national tours sell out in minutes. You like their music well enough, but you are not a big fan of either.

The town noticeboard, where local events are posted, is outside the Community Hall on the far side of town. Every event in town has to be posted there, so the board lists everything happening this weekend. Getting there and back takes a short bus ride that is free.
